text: The second test is easier to miss. The same source says that a well-measured double-neutron star system also breaks the chain if the two stellar masses differ by more than 4%. This is not a backup calculation invented later. It appears in the source's own falsifier sentence, joined to the heavy star test by the word OR. That matters. The single star evidence does not have to cross our strict 2.00 threshold if the independent binary test has already crossed its own threshold.
